title: Add idempotency handling to payment retries
intent: Add idempotency handling to payment retries so the same order cannot be charged twice.
acceptance_criteria: A client can supply an idempotency key when charging an order
Retrying a charge with the same idempotency key returns the original payment
A new idempotency key creates a genuinely new charge
expected_risks: This targets the same underlying gap as task_011.json (duplicate charges on retry) but is framed as an explicit feature request rather than a bug report — included separately to test whether the system reasons about the same code consistently from a differently-worded intent
Duplicate charges are a direct financial risk
expected_tests: retry with same idempotency key does not duplicate charge
new idempotency key creates a separate charge
expected_failure_modes: Idempotency key accepted by the schema but not enforced by the service
Idempotency key enforced in the service but not exposed by the API
